cohort: Seventy adolescents (13-16 years old, 49% males) were included, comprising groups born very preterm due to early-onset FGR, very preterm but appropriate for gestational age (AGA), and term AGA controls.
finding: Sphericity was increased after very preterm birth and further exacerbated by early-onset FGR, indicating an additive effect on left ventricular remodeling, despite no signs of cardiac dysfunction using standard clinical measurements.
birth_weight: Groups included those with fetal growth restriction (FGR) and those appropriate for gestational age (AGA).
gest_age: Groups included those born very preterm and those born at term.
